title: pprofit20 amendment A1: the same study on M15 (registered after the M5 run, before any M15 outcome)
before_registration: M5 results known (out/results_*.json). No M15 label, net R or fill computed before this file.
code_change: pp20.py parameterised by PP_TF (M5 default). M5 rerun of WTI after the change reproduced the registered run byte for byte (out/results_WTICO_USD.registered_run.json vs out/results_WTICO_USD.json).

differences_from_M5.bars: M15 bid/ask from M1; H1 = M15 resampled on the hour; supertrend (ATR10, mult 3) on mid M15 for st_al, dst and the opposite-flip exit
differences_from_M5.trade: entry next M15 open; 1R = 1.5 x Wilder ATR14 of mid M15; 72 M15 bars max (18 h); same breakeven / 3R / flip rules
differences_from_M5.population: every M15 bar (cadence: start minute % 15 == 0), both sides
differences_from_M5.features: same 18 definitions on M15 bars; minute-of-day and H1 completion use t + 15; burst = 3 M15 bars; ATR regime = 1440 M15 bars (15 days); tod slot = 15-minute slots
differences_from_M5.fixtures: WTI and EUR/USD, last 6000 M15 bars, last 200 bars x 2 sides

unchanged: model (LR with side interaction, C = 1), quarterly expanding refit, 182-day Platt window, HGB comparator, windows, validation rule (|gap| <= 0.03 every per-side decile with n >= 1000, both windows), statistics, export rule
